title: ankur project config
description: <repo>/.claude/ankur.json, read by ankur's skills and agents; the hooks don't read it. ankur init writes architecture and adr, and from 0.4.0 proposes roles, deploy, writingSkill and promptOverrides, writing them only after the client approves. Every key but architecture and adr is optional and has a default. A reader reports each problem to the client once and never treats one as fatal. It ignores a key this schema doesn't declare and unsets a value the schema rejects, so its default applies; inside roles and promptOverrides it unsets only the bad entry, and deploy fails closed: any error inside it, an undeclared key included, unsets the whole deploy key, and production is never defaulted to false. init keeps what the client wrote, errors included, and reports them by path.

architecture.description: The architecture doc, relative to the repo root.

adr.description: The ADR directory, relative to the repo root.

featureMap.description: 0.23.0. The feature map, relative to the repo root, that the crew knowledge step updates. Default docs/features.md. A path inside the repo: no leading slash, drive letter, backslash or .. segment.

adrDir.description: 0.23.0. The directory the crew knowledge step writes decision ADRs to, relative to the repo root. Default: the adr key, else docs/adr. A path inside the repo, as featureMap is.

productDecisions.description: 0.24.0. The file that holds the crew product calls, relative to the repo root. Default docs/knowledge/product-decisions.md. A path inside the repo, as featureMap is.

staticChecks.description: The project's own static checks (lint, type check, format check), each run on a crew's head before QC. A list of {name, run}: name is unique in the list; run is a single-line shell command run with bash -c from the checkout's root, and it must only read (prettier --check, never --write). A check that fails on the head runs again on the merge base: a failure the base also has is reported and never stops the crew, a new one sends the crew to a fix round, and a check whose command cannot start is reported broken. The list is read from the merge base of the crew branch and the target, so a crew cannot change its own gate; the commands run on the head. Missing or empty: nothing runs.

knowledgeDir.description: 0.24.0. The directory of lazy knowledge docs (one topic per file, frontmatter sources and verified), relative to the repo root. Default docs/knowledge. A path inside the repo, as featureMap is.

rulesDir.description: 0.24.0. The directory of path-scoped rule files (frontmatter paths, sources, verified), relative to the repo root. Default .claude/rules. A path inside the repo, as featureMap is.

agentsIndex.description: 0.24.0. The always-loaded index of pointers that CLAUDE.md imports with @AGENTS.md, relative to the repo root. Default AGENTS.md. A path inside the repo, as featureMap is.

knowledgeBudgets.description: 0.24.0. Line budgets that knowledge-lint checks. Defaults: agentsIndex 60, persona 120, personaStandards 15 (list items under ## Standards), rule 40, featureEntry 6, doc 150. Over budget is a failure for agentsIndex, persona, personaStandards and rule (always-loaded files) and a warning for featureEntry and doc.

agentCap.description: Deprecated and ignored since ankur 0.7.0. Still accepted so older configs validate.

reworkAllowance.description: How many fresh QCs a crew may start after QC FAILs in one run, copied into a v2 plan.json. Default 1.

maxParallelCrews.description: The most crews running at once. Default 4.

heavySlots.description: How many heavy commands (`factory heavy`: full test suites, builds, browser tests) run at once across the session. A targeted green check takes no slot (0.31.0). Default from the host: max(1, min(4, floor(cpus/4), floor(totalGB/8))).

testGlobs.description: Globs (repo-relative, path.matchesGlob) naming the project's test files beyond ankur's built-in names (*.test|spec|check.*, test_*.py, *_test.py|go, tests/ test/ __tests__/ spec/ checks/ e2e/ fixtures/ dirs). The green check after a stress-fix round lists the test files changed; when no tracked file is a test file by either rule, the list is unknown and the crew gets a warning, not a stop.

targetedTests.description: 0.31.0 (speed goal item 1): how a crew's green check picks its tests. factory check maps the crew's diff to the test files that import a changed file, transitively, or that name it in a string (bin/testmap.ts selectTests), and runs those outside the heavy slot. It runs the full suite instead when reach is unclear: a config file or dependency manifest, a shared test helper or fixture, code no test reaches, or a deleted code file. A large diff selects the union of each changed file's reach (0.34.0). The full suite also runs once before merge, after the QC PASS.

runner.description: The command that runs the selected JS test files, given as arguments. Default `node --test` when package.json's test script uses it; with none known, a JS selection runs the full suite.

full.description: The full-suite command. Default `npm test` when package.json has a test script.

maxFiles.description: No effect since 0.34.0: a diff of any size selects the union of each changed file's reach. The key stays accepted so a config that sets it still validates.

fullOn.description: Globs (repo-relative, path.matchesGlob) whose change always runs the full suite.

map.description: Paths the import graph can't see, and non-JS stacks: a changed file a `paths` glob matches adds the `tests` files and the `run` command (for example `pytest tests/api` or `npm --prefix ui test`). A covered file never forces the full suite.

merge.description: Merge mode of every run; the PM never asks. Default sequential.

target.description: Target branch of every run; the PM never asks. Default: the current branch.

roles.description: 0.4.0. Which agent type does each kind of crew work, by job, not by character. The PM uses a listed type when the session can start it, and otherwise picks from its inventory as in 0.3.0. A job left out is picked from the inventory. The QC, checking engineer, project manager and design engineer are always ankur's own and can't be mapped.

deploy.description: 0.4.0. How the project deploys, for the commissioning engineer's brief. A deploy to a target with production true always goes to the client first, whatever else is configured.

writingSkill.description: 0.4.0. A skill the writer member loads with the Skill tool before it writes, such as technical-writer. Used only when the session lists it; otherwise the writer says so and carries on.

promptOverrides.description: 0.4.0. Per ankur role, a prompt file in the project whose instructions the role reads in addition to its own prompt. The brief names the file; it never replaces the role's prompt, and this file never holds prompt text (P21). The hooks' rules and each role's report format still hold.

notify.description: 0.25.0. A client-owned shell command run one-way and fail-open when an inbox item is raised (contract-025 section 3).

pricing.description: 0.25.0. USD prices per million tokens, by model-id prefix; the longest key that is a prefix of a model's id applies. A model with no price makes a sum unpriced (null), never 0 (contract-025 section 4). The plugin writes no price itself.

budget.description: 0.25.0. Spend limits in USD, each above 0, checked at member start (contract-025 section 4). workTypes sets a tighter per-crew limit for a work type.

workTypes.description: 0.25.0. Per work type, a profile that may only tighten the built-in one: minProcess may only rise, stressTest and red may only become true. A loosening is reported by factory worktypes (contract-025 section 5).

intake.description: 0.25.0. Where factory intake reads work from (contract-025 section 6). Defaults: sources ["md"], queueFile docs/queue.md, ghLabel ankur, claimTtlHours 24.

runEndRetro.description: Who decides when the full retro (judges, triage, fix goal) starts. Unset (the default): run end does the scripted counts only, and the full retro starts when fullRetroEvery runs have finished since the last full retro, when a counted run holds a RECURRED line, or when the client runs /ankur:retro. pm: the scripted counts always run and the PM decides from stated triggers. off: only the scripted counts run.

fullRetroEvery.description: How many runs must have finished since the last full retro before the next full retro starts at run end. Used when runEndRetro is unset.

price.description: One model prefix's prices in USD per million tokens; fast applies to a row with speed fast.

longContext.description: 0.29.0. Rates for a request whose prompt (input, cache reads and cache writes) is over abovePromptTokens tokens, such as Claude Haiku 5.5 over 100,000. A fast row never uses them.

agentType.description: A full agent type: a project or built-in type, or plugin:name.

promptFile.description: A markdown file directly under .claude/ankur/prompts/, relative to the repo root.
